tasks.title: Collaudare il ciclo su una piccola fixture isolata con test inizialmente fallente
tasks.scope: An ephemeral Git fixture containing only a documented normalization function and its unit test, outside JARVIS production code.
tasks.fixture_requirement: Normalize an integer percentage to 0..100; reject bool and non-integers with ValueError.
tasks.initial_fixture_defect: The intentionally defective fixture initially accepts bool because bool subclasses int.
acceptance_criteria: Label the fixture and its defect as synthetic; do not report a JARVIS bug.
Record a real failing baseline test.
Select roles automatically and start at most four agents including coordinator.
Implement the small correction on an isolated task branch.
Record a passing test exit code and independent review.
Exercise STOP on an owned sleeping fixture child without stopping other processes.
Produce the patch and cycle report without merging into JARVIS.

new_findings: Proposals only until reproducible evidence and task authorization exist.
